why: Files over the 500 line limit that are recorded rather than split, each with the length it was recorded at. The length is a ceiling, not a pass: scripts/check-modularity.mjs fails the build on a file that grows past its recorded number, and fails it again on a row whose file has come back inside the limit and is still listed. The list only shrinks.
